analysis.title: Electric Halftone Intelligence Field
analysis.notes: A black central field is framed by dense, multicolored circular halftone forms that resemble a glowing data landscape or abstract globe. Large centered white typography creates a calm focal point against the highly saturated, technically rendered backdrop.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a wide cinematic abstract hero visual on a pure black background, built from thousands of evenly spaced circular halftone dots. Arrange luminous regions like a fragmented digital globe or flowing data field around a large empty black center, using electric blue, cyan, lime, yellow, orange, magenta, and violet gradients. Vary dot density to create soft fades, glowing contours, and layered depth while preserving a crisp geometric grid. Keep the composition balanced and immersive, with strong negative space in the middle for later typography. No logos, symbols, interface text, or recognizable objects.
